title: Everyone is Wrong About Mexican Coke (Even @johnnyharris)
summary: ACS Reactions investigates why Mexican Coke, supposedly cane sugar sweetened, tested as having glucose and fructose, explaining that sucrose breaks down in acidic soda.
why: Linked in corn syrup and Coca-Cola threads to show that sugar type barely matters in soda because sucrose inverts into the same sugars.

quote.text: Fun video about the sucrose in Mexican coke
